how_to_apply: Visit the official Shri Govind Guru University website at www.sggu.ac.in.
Locate the recruitment notification for affiliated self-financed colleges under Advertisement No. 02/SF/2026.
Read the advertisement and check the available college-wise and subject-wise vacancies.
Open the Samarth online application link provided on the university website.
Fill in the prescribed online application form with the required personal, educational and other information.
Upload copies of all necessary certificates and the NOC, where applicable.
Pay the prescribed Rs. 500 application fee online through the Samarth portal.
Review the completed application carefully and submit it by 30 October 2026.
Save or print a copy of the submitted online application.
Check the university website and registered email address for the subject-wise interview schedule.
Attend the interview at the specified time and venue with the application printout and required certificates.
Important Application Notice: Incomplete applications and applications without the prescribed online fee will not be accepted. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The university has listed 632 academic staff vacancies across 85 affiliated self-financed colleges. Assistant Professor accounts for the highest number of posts.

content_sections.heading: SGGU College-Wise Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The official vacancy annexure provides a course-wise and college-category-wise breakup covering Arts, Commerce, Science, Education, Nursing, Law, Social Work, Medical and other programmes. Important: The figures above represent vacancies grouped by college/course category, not individual named institutions. Applicants should check the detailed college-wise and subject-wise list on the SGGU website to identify the vacancies relevant to their qualification.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and other eligibility requirements for the selected academic post and subject, as specified in the university's detailed recruitment information. Candidates should review the university's official post-wise and subject-wise requirements before completing the online application.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Applicants must pay the prescribed application fee of Rs. 500 online through the Samarth portal . Applications submitted without payment of the required fee or with incomplete information will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants will be required to attend an interview at the date, time and venue announced by Shri Govind Guru University. The tentative interview dates are 3 and 4 November 2026 . Subject-wise interview details will be communicated through the university website and candidates' email addresses. Submission of online application through the Samarth portal. Scrutiny of application details and uploaded certificates. Attendance at the scheduled interview. Verification of original certificates and application documents at the interview. Further selection and appointment procedures as notified by the university.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for SGGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates attending the interview must bring the following: One hard copy of the completed online application form. Original educational qualification certificates. Copies of the relevant educational and supporting certificates for verification. No Objection Certificate, if applicable. Other documents required by the university for the selected post. Interview Document Requirement: Candidates must bring a printed copy of their submitted online application and the necessary original certificates and copies for verification at the interview venue. The notice does not direct candidates to send a hard copy by post at the application stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important Application Notice: Incomplete applications and applications without the prescribed online fee will not be accepted. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Recruitment 2026 Interview Details
content_sections.text: Applicants should follow the schedule issued for their particular subject or post. The tentative interview dates may be revised through official communication.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The recruitment is for affiliated self-financed colleges under Shri Govind Guru University. Applications must be submitted online through the Samarth portal. The last date for submitting the online application is 30 October 2026. Applicants must pay the Rs. 500 application fee online. Required certificates and the applicable NOC must be uploaded with the application. College-wise and subject-wise vacancy information is available through the university website. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense. The university will provide subject-wise interview information through its website and email communication.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in SGGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shri Govind Guru University has listed 632 academic staff vacancies across 85 affiliated self-financed colleges.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SGGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are included in SGGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Principal, Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor, Librarian, Physical Training Instructor and Tutor posts.

faq.question: Q4. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 386 Assistant Professor vacancies across different affiliated self-financed college categories.

faq.question: Q5. How many Principal vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The vacancy annexure lists 49 Principal posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the SGGU Recruitment 2026 application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500, payable online through the Samarth portal.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SGGU Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification specifies interviews and certificate verification. It does not provide a separate written examination scheme.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to bring a hard copy to the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must bring a printed hard copy of their submitted online application form along with all original certificates and testimonials at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the application fee refundable?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any refund policy for the application fee. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making the payment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the subject-wise vacancy details?
faq.answer: Detailed subject-wise vacancy information for the various posts can be viewed directly on the official website of Shri Govind Guru University, Godhra.
